changeSet.comment: nexus.reaper_quarantine_chunks: the periodic reaper's move. Selects with nexus.chunk_is_reapable (injectable grace), takes the exclusive sweep gate, refuses a move over the fraction floor, copies to the quarantine sibling through the DELETE's own RETURNING with the predicate in the DELETE's WHERE, writes one actor engine-reaper gc_audit row. Dry-run form counts only.
